name: Ang Mo Kio
summary: Large mature north-central town with NSL hub access, AMK Hub errands, and park connectors — value-leaning heartland with real food density.
body: Ang Mo Kio shows up whenever renters ask for space and hawkers without paying Queenstown or River Valley premiums. Ang Mo Kio MRT anchors a full town centre (AMK Hub, markets, clinics); park connectors and nearby Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park give weekend running and pram loops that pure mall towns lack. Housing is overwhelmingly mature HDB with scattered condos — whole-flat stock is the expat value lever if HDB approval and nationality rules clear. Commute reality: NSL to CBD is straightforward; cross-island offices still punish you at peak. Industrial and hub edges can feel busier and pricier than quiet interior avenues — walk the exact block at 8am. Watch-outs: estate upgrading / construction on specific plots, dengue-season cluster notices in dense mature towns, and bedroom-rental continuous-occupation traps. Compare with Toa Payoh for tighter central-north hops, Bishan for interchange + park prestige, or Sengkang if you prefer newer flats and accept NEL length.
watchOuts: Hub vs interior rent and noise gaps
Dengue-season cluster density in mature estates
housingMix: Mature HDB majority, some condo and executive pockets.
commuteNotes: North-South Line at Ang Mo Kio; verify bus/feeders if your block is a long walk from the hub.
